description: Phase-start autosave: at the start of each phase the controlling player writes/overwrites a save named 'R<round> - <army1> vs <army2> - <phase>'. On by default with a Settings > Gameplay toggle. This drives real PhaseManager transitions (the same signal a player's End Phase triggers) and asserts (a) the round-prefixed named save appears when ON, does NOT appear when the toggle is OFF, and reappears when turned back ON; (b) the save's metadata records the REAL battle round (it used to record meta.turn_number, a dead counter stuck at 1, so every save card read 'Turn: 1'); (c) the Save/Load dialog's list row and tooltip show that round back to the player.

steps.script:
var n = SaveLoadManager._phase_start_save_name(7)
var want = "R2 - %s vs %s - Movement" % [GameState.get_faction_name(1), GameState.get_faction_name(2)]
SaveLoadManager.delete_save_file(n)
PhaseManager.transition_to_phase(7)
return n if n != want else "ok"

var n = "R%d - %s vs %s - Movement" % [GameState.get_battle_round(), GameState.get_faction_name(1), GameState.get_faction_name(2)]
return SaveLoadManager.save_exists(n)

var d = tree.root.get_node("/root/Main/SaveLoadDialog")
var lst = d.saves_list
var r = lst.get_item_rect(0)
var p = lst.get_global_rect().position + r.position + r.size * 0.5
p.y -= lst.get_v_scroll_bar().value
Input.warp_mouse(p)
for down in [true, false]:
	var ev = InputEventMouseButton.new()
	ev.button_index = MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT
	ev.pressed = down
	ev.position = p
	ev.global_position = p
	Input.parse_input_event(ev)
return true

var t = tree.root.get_node("/root/Main/SaveLoadDialog").preview_label.get_parsed_text()
return t if not ("Round 2" in t) else "ok"

var d = tree.root.get_node("/root/Main/SaveLoadDialog")
var lst = d.saves_list
var r = lst.get_item_rect(0)
var p = lst.get_global_rect().position + r.position + r.size * 0.5
p.y -= lst.get_v_scroll_bar().value
Input.warp_mouse(p)
var ev = InputEventMouseMotion.new()
ev.position = p
ev.global_position = p
Input.parse_input_event(ev)
return true

var d = tree.root.get_node("/root/Main/SaveLoadDialog")
d.filter_input.text = ""
d._on_filter_text_changed("")
d.hide()
return true

SettingsService.set_autosave_on_phase_start(false)
var n = "R%d - %s vs %s - Command" % [GameState.get_battle_round(), GameState.get_faction_name(1), GameState.get_faction_name(2)]
SaveLoadManager.delete_save_file(n)
PhaseManager.transition_to_phase(6)
return SaveLoadManager.autosave_on_phase_start

var n = "R%d - %s vs %s - Command" % [GameState.get_battle_round(), GameState.get_faction_name(1), GameState.get_faction_name(2)]
return SaveLoadManager.save_exists(n)

SettingsService.set_autosave_on_phase_start(true)
var n = "R%d - %s vs %s - Movement" % [GameState.get_battle_round(), GameState.get_faction_name(1), GameState.get_faction_name(2)]
SaveLoadManager.delete_save_file(n)
PhaseManager.transition_to_phase(7)
return true

var n = "R%d - %s vs %s - Movement" % [GameState.get_battle_round(), GameState.get_faction_name(1), GameState.get_faction_name(2)]
return SaveLoadManager.save_exists(n)
